name: umbrella
positive: A tiny minimalist flat icon of an umbrella on a pure white background. One single solid pink dome canopy shape and one dark gray handle, nothing else. Absolutely no shading, no gradients, no shadows, no tint, no rounded photo corners, no border. The umbrella is small, centered, occupying only the middle 15 percent of the image, surrounded by large empty pure white space. Childrens sticker, solid color shapes, 2D flat design.
